```sql
0.6 BASELINE DEFAULT VS CAMPAIGN CHALLENGER EXAMPLES
====================================================================================================

Baseline default strategy:

    BASELINE_STRATEGY

Campaign challenger examples:

    TIGHTER_SYNTHETIC_RISK_STRATEGY
        Lowers synthetic estimated-risk thresholds to reduce approved Expected Loss and improve the
        offered-population risk profile.

    GROWTH_ORIENTED_STRATEGY
        Expands approval and offer exposure using growth-oriented thresholds and product policy.

    TIGHTER_AFFORDABILITY_STRATEGY
        Tightens PTI and DTI posture to reduce payment-burden stress.

    SELECTIVE_COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_STRATEGY
        Uses governed reduced-exposure treatment where counteroffer feasibility is clean, while
        preserving review-oriented handling for severe requested-structure cases.

    AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_EXPANSION_STRATEGY
        Routes more severe requested-structure cases into governed counteroffer feasibility testing,
        without bypassing hard policy stops, severe synthetic estimated-risk, severe DTI logic, or
        counteroffer feasibility constraints.

    PRODUCT_SPECIFIC_GUARDRAIL_STRATEGY
        Tightens unsecured personal loan and revolving line policy while leaving secured / auto
        products stable.

    MANUAL_REVIEW_REDUCTION_STRATEGY
        Resolves failed counteroffer cases to DECLINE rather than MANUAL_REVIEW to test operational
        review-burden reduction.

Important:
    The active selected run may use any strategy.
    The default reference strategy remains BASELINE_STRATEGY.

Legacy naming note:
    COUNTEROFFER_FIRST_EXPOSURE_STRATEGY is a legacy interpretation label only.

    It should not be used as the primary formal-campaign strategy name in the final V1.0 campaign.

    The formal counteroffer strategy split is:
        SELECTIVE_COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_STRATEGY
        AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_EXPANSION_STRATEGY

0.7 FORMAL CAMPAIGN SCENARIO FRAMEWORK
====================================================================================================

The formal Module 2 campaign is organized into seven scenario families:

    SC01 — Baseline Strategy Frontier
        Compare multiple Module 2 strategies on the same Module 1 BASELINE_V2 population.

    SC02 — Rate Environment Sensitivity
        Test strategy behavior under RATE_UP_200BP, RATE_UP_300BP, and RATE_DOWN_200BP.

    SC03 — Credit Box Sensitivity
        Test strategy behavior under prime-growth, near-prime expansion, and credit-stress score mix.

    SC04 — Portfolio Mix Sensitivity
        Test strategy behavior under unsecured growth, secured balance growth, and revolving-line
        expansion.

    SC05 — Exposure Intensity Sensitivity
        Test strategy behavior under exposure baseline, high-balance appetite, and low-balance
        conservative request scenarios.

    SC06 — LGD Severity Sensitivity
        Test strategy behavior under secured severity, unsecured severity, and broad LGD stress.

    SC07 — Option C Counteroffer Strategy Split
        Test aggressive counteroffer expansion under BASELINE_V2, NEAR_PRIME_EXPANSION_MIX, and
        HIGH_BALANCE_APPETITE.

        This scenario family allows reviewers to compare:
            baseline strategy,
            selective counteroffer feasibility,
            and aggressive counteroffer expansion

        while holding the selected Module 1 scenario and population constant.

Formal campaign shape:
    The standard campaign catalog contains 39 Module 2 runs:

        M2-01 through M2-36:
            original formal campaign foundation.

        M2-37 through M2-39:
            Option C aggressive counteroffer expansion addendum.

    The standard comparison registry contains 20 comparison groups.

Option C comparison design:
    CG04, CG11, and CG15 compare baseline strategy against the selective counteroffer feasibility
    posture.

    CG18, CG19, and CG20 compare baseline strategy against the aggressive counteroffer expansion
    posture.

    This lets reviewers evaluate the tradeoff between:
        safer, review-oriented counteroffer feasibility
        and
        more expansion-oriented counteroffer routing.

These campaign scenarios are examples of how the engine can be used.

Users may add custom scenarios and custom strategies, but formal campaign evidence should remain
registry-matched, parameter-snapshot captured, synchronized where needed, and validation-reviewed.

0.11 VALIDATION AND ACCEPTANCE GUIDANCE
====================================================================================================

A successful SQL run is not the same as a validated strategy run.

A completed run should be reviewed across:

    1. Structural integrity
        row count, application_id uniqueness, strategy lineage, and Module 1 scenario lineage.

    2. Final outcome integrity
        one final decision outcome per row and final flags reconcile.

    3. Amount and economics conventions
        APPROVE preserves requested exposure;
        COUNTEROFFER reduces exposure;
        MANUAL_REVIEW remains unresolved;
        DECLINE uses zero-exposure convention.

    4. Risk and affordability behavior
        synthetic estimated-risk tiers, requested PTI buckets, DTI buckets, requested versus approved
        PTI.

    5. Counteroffer behavior
        feasibility pass / fail, exposure reduction, approved PTI target, approved Expected Loss cap,
        ordinary counteroffer candidacy, aggressive counteroffer override routing, and final
        aggressive override outcome mix.

    6. Reason-code coverage
        every row explainable; reason family aligns to final outcome; aggressive override rows retain
        path-specific reason-code traceability.

    7. Archive persistence
        archived slice row count equals latest-run row count; archive grain is unique; Option C
        counteroffer split fields persist without distortion.

    8. Matched comparison
        baseline and challenger share the same Module 1 scenario and population; source fields match;
        Option C path movement is interpreted as downstream strategy movement, not source drift.

    9. Frontier and evidence capture
        Section 15 summarizes strategy tradeoffs; Section 16 stores evidence; Section 16.9 refreshes
        Section 15-derived frontier fields after the completed campaign archive is available.

    10. Final campaign acceptance
        Section 17 validates the full campaign archive, registry, comparison, evidence, convention,
        parameter snapshot, product-policy audit, Option C evidence-readiness, and final acceptance
        state.

0.12 TERMINOLOGY AND INTERPRETATION BOUNDARIES
====================================================================================================

estimated_pd:
    The SQL field name estimated_pd is retained because it is the finalized Module 1 output field.

    In Module 2 commentary, QA, reporting, and documentation, estimated_pd should be interpreted as
    the synthetic estimated-PD proxy.

    Module 2 V1.0 does not recalculate estimated_pd.

requested_expected_loss_amount:
    Module 2 alias for Module 1 expected_loss_amount.

    It represents requested-exposure Expected Loss.

approved_expected_loss_amount:
    Module 2 simulated approved-exposure Expected Loss after exposure treatment.

    Conceptual formula:
        approved_expected_loss_amount = approved_amount × estimated_pd × estimated_lgd

    estimated_pd remains the synthetic estimated-PD proxy input.

requested_payment_to_income_ratio:
    Module 2 alias for Module 1 payment_to_income_ratio.

    It represents the original requested-structure PTI.

approved_payment_to_income_ratio:
    Module 2 post-exposure-treatment affordability proxy for simulated positive offer-exposure rows.

approved_monthly_payment_proxy:
    Module 2 strategy-simulation proxy for approved payment burden.

    For reduced-exposure counteroffers, the proxy uses proportional scaling:

        approved_monthly_payment_proxy =
            requested_monthly_payment_proxy × approved_amount / requested_amount

    It is not a recalculated contractual payment schedule.

simulated_offer_exposure_flag:
    TRUE for:
        APPROVE
        COUNTEROFFER

    FALSE for:
        MANUAL_REVIEW
        DECLINE

    It indicates simulated positive offer exposure only.
    It does not imply operational account creation, funding, real applicant treatment, or an
    operational approval.

counteroffer_strategy_variant:
    Module 2 field that identifies the Option C counteroffer strategy posture.

    Expected values include:
        NOT_COUNTEROFFER_SPLIT_STRATEGY
        SELECTIVE_FEASIBILITY
        AGGRESSIVE_EXPANSION

ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_flag:
    Row-level evidence that the applicant qualified for ordinary governed counteroffer candidacy.

aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag:
    Row-level evidence that the applicant entered counteroffer feasibility through the aggressive
    requested-structure override path.

    This flag does not guarantee a final COUNTEROFFER.

    Aggressive override rows still must pass:
        hard policy-stop controls,
        severe synthetic estimated-risk controls,
        severe DTI controls,
        product maximum approved amount,
        product minimum approved amount,
        minimum counteroffer percent,
        maximum exposure reduction,
        approved PTI target,
        approved Expected Loss cap,
        and rounding rules.

reason codes:
    Module 2 reason codes are simulated strategy explanation codes.

    They support:
        auditability,
        QA review,
        strategy interpretation,
        portfolio diagnostics,
        decision-path traceability,
        and validation evidence.

    They are not customer communications or regulatory notices.

MANUAL_REVIEW:
    MANUAL_REVIEW is unresolved by design.

    Manual-review rows receive:
        approved_amount = NULL
        approved_monthly_payment_proxy = NULL
        approved_payment_to_income_ratio = NULL
        approved_expected_loss_amount = NULL

DECLINE:
    DECLINE follows the zero-exposure convention.

    Decline rows receive:
        approved_amount = 0
        approved_monthly_payment_proxy = 0
        approved_payment_to_income_ratio = 0
        approved_expected_loss_amount = 0

====================================================================================================
0.13 FINAL DECISION TAXONOMY
====================================================================================================

Module 2 uses exactly four final decision_outcome values:

    APPROVE
    COUNTEROFFER
    MANUAL_REVIEW
    DECLINE

APPROVE:
    Clean simulated positive offer outcome as requested.

COUNTEROFFER:
    Simulated positive offer outcome with reduced approved exposure.
    COUNTEROFFER is distinct from APPROVE.

MANUAL_REVIEW:
    Unresolved simulated strategy outcome.
    No approved exposure or approved Expected Loss is assigned.

DECLINE:
    Simulated no-offer outcome using the zero-exposure convention.

====================================================================================================
0.14 COUNTEROFFER DESIGN BOUNDARY
====================================================================================================

COUNTEROFFER is a distinct final decision_outcome.

A preliminary counteroffer route does not guarantee a final feasible counteroffer.

Final COUNTEROFFER is assigned only after approved exposure, approved PTI, and approved Expected Loss
feasibility have been evaluated.

Option C counteroffer split:
    SELECTIVE_COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_STRATEGY:
        Tests ordinary governed counteroffer candidates.

    AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_EXPANSION_STRATEGY:
        Tests ordinary governed counteroffer candidates plus governed aggressive requested-structure
        override candidates.

Aggressive expansion boundary:
    Aggressive expansion expands routing into counteroffer feasibility testing.

    It does not bypass:
        hard simulated policy stops,
        severe synthetic estimated-risk routing,
        severe DTI routing,
        product-level counteroffer permission,
        product caps,
        minimum viable amount rules,
        minimum counteroffer percent,
        maximum exposure-reduction rules,
        approved PTI target,
        approved Expected Loss cap,
        or final failed-counteroffer resolution logic.

More detailed counteroffer interpretation is captured through:
    decision_path,
    counteroffer feasibility diagnostics,
    exposure-treatment fields,
    Option C ordinary/aggressive path fields,
    simulated reason codes,
    QA outputs,
    frontier summaries,
    and evidence tables.
```

```sql
                         OR counteroffer_amount IS DISTINCT FROM approved_amount
                    )
                  )
               OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                    AND (
                            approved_amount IS NOT NULL
                         OR counteroffer_amount IS NOT NULL
                    )
                  )
               OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                    AND (
                            approved_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
                         OR counteroffer_amount IS NOT NULL
                    )
                  )
        ) AS approved_amount_convention_gap_rows,

        /*******************************************************************************************
        Approved Expected Loss convention checks.

        APPROVE / COUNTEROFFER:
            approved_expected_loss_amount should equal approved_amount × estimated_pd × estimated_lgd.

        MANUAL_REVIEW:
            approved_expected_loss_amount should remain NULL.

        DECLINE:
            approved_expected_loss_amount should be zero.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE (
                    decision_outcome IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER')
                    AND (
                            approved_expected_loss_amount IS NULL
                         OR ROUND(approved_expected_loss_amount::NUMERIC, 6)
                            IS DISTINCT FROM
                            ROUND((approved_amount * estimated_pd * estimated_lgd)::NUMERIC, 6)
                    )
                  )
               OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                    AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS NOT NULL
                  )
               OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                    AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
                  )
        ) AS approved_expected_loss_convention_gap_rows,

        /*******************************************************************************************
        Reason-code completeness and outcome-family alignment.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE primary_reason_code IS NULL
               OR primary_reason_family IS NULL
               OR triggered_reason_code_list IS NULL
               OR reason_priority_rank IS NULL
               OR reason_code_count IS NULL
               OR reason_code_count < 1
        ) AS reason_code_gap_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE (
                    decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                    AND primary_reason_family IS DISTINCT FROM 'APPROVAL'
                  )
               OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                    AND primary_reason_family IS DISTINCT FROM 'COUNTEROFFER'
                  )
               OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                    AND primary_reason_family IS DISTINCT FROM 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                  )
               OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                    AND primary_reason_family IS DISTINCT FROM 'POLICY_STOP'
                  )
        ) AS reason_family_alignment_gap_rows,

        /*******************************************************************************************
        Final outcome distribution.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
        ) AS approve_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
        ) AS counteroffer_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
        ) AS manual_review_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
        ) AS decline_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE
        ) AS simulated_offer_exposure_rows,

        /*******************************************************************************************
        Option C counteroffer split latest-run readiness checks.

        Purpose:
            Confirm the latest-run output preserved the ordinary-versus-aggressive counteroffer path
            evidence created upstream.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE counteroffer_strategy_variant IS NULL
               OR aggressive_counteroffer_expansion_enabled IS NULL
               OR severe_requested_structure_counteroffer_override_enabled IS NULL
               OR exposure_extreme_counteroffer_override_enabled IS NULL
               OR exposure_policy_stop_counteroffer_override_enabled IS NULL
               OR requested_pti_decline_counteroffer_override_enabled IS NULL
               OR requested_el_decline_counteroffer_override_enabled IS NULL
               OR ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_flag IS NULL
               OR aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS NULL
        ) AS option_c_field_gap_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_flag IS TRUE
        ) AS ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
        ) AS aggressive_override_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
              AND decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
        ) AS aggressive_override_final_counteroffer_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
              AND decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
        ) AS aggressive_override_final_manual_review_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
              AND decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
        ) AS aggressive_override_final_decline_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
              AND decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
              AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') LIKE
                    '%COUNTEROFFER_AGGRESSIVE_EXPANSION_OVERRIDE%'
        ) AS aggressive_override_counteroffer_reason_trace_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
              AND decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
              AND preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
              AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
              AND failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
              AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') LIKE
                    '%MANUAL_REVIEW_AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE%'
        ) AS aggressive_override_manual_review_reason_trace_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
              AND decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
              AND preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
              AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
              AND failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'DECLINE'
              AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') LIKE
                    '%POLICY_STOP_AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE%'
        ) AS aggressive_override_decline_reason_trace_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
              AND (
                    (
                        decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                        AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') NOT LIKE
                            '%COUNTEROFFER_AGGRESSIVE_EXPANSION_OVERRIDE%'
                    )
                 OR (
                        decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                        AND preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                        AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
                        AND failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                        AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') NOT LIKE
                            '%MANUAL_REVIEW_AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE%'
                    )
                 OR (
                        decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                        AND preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                        AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
                        AND failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'DECLINE'
                        AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') NOT LIKE
                            '%POLICY_STOP_AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE%'
                    )
              )
        ) AS aggressive_override_reason_trace_gap_rows

    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
)

SELECT
    latest_run_row_count,
    distinct_application_id_count,

    distinct_strategy_identity_count,
    distinct_module1_scenario_population_count,

    required_metadata_gap_rows,
    latest_output_created_ts_null_rows,

    final_decision_gap_rows,
    final_flag_reconciliation_gap_rows,
    simulated_offer_exposure_flag_gap_rows,

    approved_amount_convention_gap_rows,
    approved_expected_loss_convention_gap_rows,

    reason_code_gap_rows,
    reason_family_alignment_gap_rows,

    approve_rows,
    counteroffer_rows,
    manual_review_rows,
    decline_rows,
    simulated_offer_exposure_rows,

    option_c_field_gap_rows,
    ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_rows,
    aggressive_override_rows,
    aggressive_override_final_counteroffer_rows,
    aggressive_override_final_manual_review_rows,
    aggressive_override_final_decline_rows,
    aggressive_override_counteroffer_reason_trace_rows,
    aggressive_override_manual_review_reason_trace_rows,
    aggressive_override_decline_reason_trace_rows,
    aggressive_override_reason_trace_gap_rows,

    CASE
        WHEN latest_run_row_count > 0
         AND latest_run_row_count = distinct_application_id_count
         AND distinct_strategy_identity_count = 1
         AND distinct_module1_scenario_population_count = 1
         AND required_metadata_gap_rows = 0
         AND latest_output_created_ts_null_rows = 0
         AND final_decision_gap_rows = 0
         AND final_flag_reconciliation_gap_rows = 0
         AND simulated_offer_exposure_flag_gap_rows = 0
         AND approved_amount_convention_gap_rows = 0
         AND approved_expected_loss_convention_gap_rows = 0
         AND reason_code_gap_rows = 0
         AND reason_family_alignment_gap_rows = 0
         AND option_c_field_gap_rows = 0
         AND aggressive_override_reason_trace_gap_rows = 0
            THEN 'SECTION_11_LATEST_RUN_OUTPUT_READY_FOR_ARCHIVE_PERSISTENCE'

        ELSE 'REVIEW_SECTION_11_LATEST_RUN_OUTPUT_BEFORE_ARCHIVE_PERSISTENCE'
    END AS section_11_latest_run_output_status

FROM latest_run_summary;
```

While running M2-01, encountered the following error: SQL Error [42703]: ERROR: column ar.option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_count does not exist
  Position: 1215
  ERROR: column ar.option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_count does not exist
  Position: 1215

This is a **Section 12.8.13 readiness-summary bug**, not a problem with M2-01 output.

The current 12.8.13 `current_archive` CTE is trying to select these as if they were physical columns on `strategy_decisions_archive`:

```sql
ar.option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_count,
ar.option_c_archive_reason_trace_gap_count,
ar.aggressive_override_archived_rows,
ar.aggressive_override_archived_counteroffer_rows,
ar.aggressive_override_archived_manual_review_rows,
ar.aggressive_override_archived_decline_rows
```

But those are **diagnostic aggregates**, not archive-table columns. The archive table has row-level fields such as `counteroffer_strategy_variant`, `ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_flag`, and `aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag`; the summary query needs to **calculate** those aggregate counts. The current Section 12.8.13 snippet confirms it is selecting `ar.option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_count` directly from the archive alias `ar`, which causes the PostgreSQL `column does not exist` error. fileciteturn352file2

Section 12.1 correctly validates latest-run Option C fields before archive persistence with a PL/pgSQL variable named `v_option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_count`; that variable is local to the `DO $$` block and is not a persistent archive column. fileciteturn352file0

## Fix

Replace the full current **12.8.13 Section 12 readiness summary** block with this version.

```sql
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
12.8.13 Section 12 readiness summary.

Purpose:
    Provide one compact readiness row for archive persistence.

Expected:
    If archive_run_flag = TRUE:
        SECTION_12_ARCHIVE_PERSISTENCE_READY_FOR_COMPARISON_AND_QA

    If archive_run_flag = FALSE:
        SECTION_12_ARCHIVE_PERSISTENCE_SKIPPED_BY_CONTROL

Interpretation:
    This confirms only Section 12 archive persistence status.

    It does not validate Section 13 comparison readiness.
    It does not validate Section 14 QA.
    It does not validate Section 15 frontier completeness.
    It does not validate Section 16 evidence capture.

Implementation correction:
    Option C archive diagnostics are aggregate checks.

    They are not physical columns on credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive.

    Therefore this readiness summary calculates:
        option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_count
        option_c_archive_reason_trace_gap_count
        aggressive_override_archived_rows
        aggressive_override_archived_counteroffer_rows
        aggressive_override_archived_manual_review_rows
        aggressive_override_archived_decline_rows

    from the current archived slice and the latest-run table.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

WITH audit_row AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM tmp_m2_archive_persistence_audit
    LIMIT 1
),

latest_run_current AS (
    SELECT
        sd.*
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions sd

    JOIN audit_row a
        ON a.strategy_set_name = sd.strategy_set_name
       AND a.strategy_name = sd.strategy_name
       AND a.strategy_version = sd.strategy_version
       AND a.module1_scenario_set_name = sd.module1_scenario_set_name
       AND a.module1_scenario_name = sd.module1_scenario_name
       AND a.population_id = sd.population_id
),

archive_current AS (
    SELECT
        ar.*
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ar

    JOIN audit_row a
        ON ar.strategy_set_name = a.strategy_set_name
       AND ar.strategy_name = a.strategy_name
       AND ar.strategy_version = a.strategy_version
       AND ar.module1_scenario_set_name = a.module1_scenario_set_name
       AND ar.module1_scenario_name = a.module1_scenario_name
       AND ar.population_id = a.population_id
),

latest_archive_compare AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(l.application_id, ar.application_id)
            AS application_id,

        l.application_id AS latest_application_id,
        ar.application_id AS archived_application_id,

        /*******************************************************************************************
        Option C latest-run versus archive field mismatch flag.

        This compares row-level Option C evidence between the latest-run table and the archived
        current slice.

        Row absence on either side is also treated as a gap.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        CASE
            WHEN l.application_id IS NULL
              OR ar.application_id IS NULL
                THEN TRUE

            WHEN l.counteroffer_strategy_variant
                    IS DISTINCT FROM ar.counteroffer_strategy_variant
              OR l.aggressive_counteroffer_expansion_enabled
                    IS DISTINCT FROM ar.aggressive_counteroffer_expansion_enabled
              OR l.severe_requested_structure_counteroffer_override_enabled
                    IS DISTINCT FROM ar.severe_requested_structure_counteroffer_override_enabled
              OR l.exposure_extreme_counteroffer_override_enabled
                    IS DISTINCT FROM ar.exposure_extreme_counteroffer_override_enabled
              OR l.exposure_policy_stop_counteroffer_override_enabled
                    IS DISTINCT FROM ar.exposure_policy_stop_counteroffer_override_enabled
              OR l.requested_pti_decline_counteroffer_override_enabled
                    IS DISTINCT FROM ar.requested_pti_decline_counteroffer_override_enabled
              OR l.requested_el_decline_counteroffer_override_enabled
                    IS DISTINCT FROM ar.requested_el_decline_counteroffer_override_enabled
              OR l.ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_flag
                    IS DISTINCT FROM ar.ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_flag
              OR l.aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag
                    IS DISTINCT FROM ar.aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag
                THEN TRUE

            ELSE FALSE
        END AS option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_flag

    FROM latest_run_current l

    FULL OUTER JOIN archive_current ar
        ON ar.application_id = l.application_id
),

current_archive AS (
    SELECT
        a.archive_run_flag,
        a.strategy_archive_reset_mode,
        a.strategy_set_name,
        a.strategy_name,
        a.strategy_version,
        a.module1_scenario_set_name,
        a.module1_scenario_name,
        a.population_id,

        /*******************************************************************************************
        Current archived slice structural counts.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM archive_current
        ) AS current_archived_slice_rows,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
            FROM archive_current
        ) AS current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM archive_current
            WHERE archive_inserted_ts IS NULL
        ) AS current_archived_slice_null_archive_ts_rows,

        /*******************************************************************************************
        Option C latest-run versus archive persistence fidelity.

        This is evaluated only when archive_run_flag = TRUE.

        If archive_run_flag = FALSE, Section 12 intentionally skipped persistence, so latest-run
        versus archive equality is not required.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        CASE
            WHEN a.archive_run_flag IS TRUE
                THEN (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM latest_archive_compare
                    WHERE option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_flag IS TRUE
                )
            ELSE 0
        END AS option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_count,

        /*******************************************************************************************
        Option C aggressive override reason-trace preservation.

        These checks operate on the archived current slice.

        They confirm that aggressive override rows retained path-specific simulated reason-code
        evidence after archive persistence.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        CASE
            WHEN a.archive_run_flag IS TRUE
                THEN (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM archive_current
                    WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
                      AND (
                            (
                                decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                                AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') NOT LIKE
                                    '%COUNTEROFFER_AGGRESSIVE_EXPANSION_OVERRIDE%'
                            )
                         OR (
                                decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                                AND preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                                AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
                                AND failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                                AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') NOT LIKE
                                    '%MANUAL_REVIEW_AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE%'
                            )
                         OR (
                                decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                                AND preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                                AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
                                AND failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'DECLINE'
                                AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') NOT LIKE
                                    '%POLICY_STOP_AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE%'
                            )
                      )
                )
            ELSE 0
        END AS option_c_archive_reason_trace_gap_count,

        CASE
            WHEN a.archive_run_flag IS TRUE
                THEN (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM archive_current
                    WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
                )
            ELSE 0
        END AS aggressive_override_archived_rows,

        CASE
            WHEN a.archive_run_flag IS TRUE
                THEN (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM archive_current
                    WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
                      AND decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                )
            ELSE 0
        END AS aggressive_override_archived_counteroffer_rows,

        CASE
            WHEN a.archive_run_flag IS TRUE
                THEN (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM archive_current
                    WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
                      AND decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                )
            ELSE 0
        END AS aggressive_override_archived_manual_review_rows,

        CASE
            WHEN a.archive_run_flag IS TRUE
                THEN (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM archive_current
                    WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
                      AND decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                )
            ELSE 0
        END AS aggressive_override_archived_decline_rows

    FROM audit_row a
),

archive_duplicates AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS duplicate_archive_grain_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            strategy_set_name,
            strategy_name,
            strategy_version,
            module1_scenario_set_name,
            module1_scenario_name,
            population_id,
            application_id,
            COUNT(*) AS row_count
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive
        GROUP BY
            strategy_set_name,
            strategy_name,
            strategy_version,
            module1_scenario_set_name,
            module1_scenario_name,
            population_id,
            application_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    ) d
),

inventory_diff AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS before_after_inventory_diff_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(b.strategy_set_name, a.strategy_set_name) AS strategy_set_name,
            COALESCE(b.strategy_name, a.strategy_name) AS strategy_name,
            COALESCE(b.strategy_version, a.strategy_version) AS strategy_version,
            COALESCE(b.module1_scenario_set_name, a.module1_scenario_set_name) AS module1_scenario_set_name,
            COALESCE(b.module1_scenario_name, a.module1_scenario_name) AS module1_scenario_name,
            COALESCE(b.population_id, a.population_id) AS population_id,
            COALESCE(b.row_count, 0) AS before_row_count,
            COALESCE(a.row_count, 0) AS after_row_count
        FROM tmp_m2_archive_inventory_before b

        FULL OUTER JOIN tmp_m2_archive_inventory_after a
            ON a.strategy_set_name = b.strategy_set_name
           AND a.strategy_name = b.strategy_name
           AND a.strategy_version = b.strategy_version
           AND a.module1_scenario_set_name = b.module1_scenario_set_name
           AND a.module1_scenario_name = b.module1_scenario_name
           AND a.population_id = b.population_id
    ) x
    WHERE before_row_count <> after_row_count
)

SELECT
    a.archive_run_flag,
    a.strategy_archive_reset_mode,

    a.strategy_set_name,
    a.strategy_name,
    a.strategy_version,
    a.module1_scenario_set_name,
    a.module1_scenario_name,
    a.population_id,

    a.latest_run_row_count,
    a.latest_run_distinct_application_count,

    a.archive_row_count_before,
    a.archive_deleted_rows,
    a.archive_inserted_rows,
    a.archive_row_count_after,
    a.archive_action,

    ca.current_archived_slice_rows,
    ca.current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count,
    ca.current_archived_slice_null_archive_ts_rows,

    ad.duplicate_archive_grain_count,
    id.before_after_inventory_diff_count,

    ca.option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_count,
    ca.option_c_archive_reason_trace_gap_count,
    ca.aggressive_override_archived_rows,
    ca.aggressive_override_archived_counteroffer_rows,
    ca.aggressive_override_archived_manual_review_rows,
    ca.aggressive_override_archived_decline_rows,

    CASE
        WHEN a.archive_run_flag IS FALSE
         AND a.archive_deleted_rows = 0
         AND a.archive_inserted_rows = 0
         AND a.archive_row_count_after = a.archive_row_count_before
         AND id.before_after_inventory_diff_count = 0
            THEN 'SECTION_12_ARCHIVE_PERSISTENCE_SKIPPED_BY_CONTROL'

        WHEN a.archive_run_flag IS TRUE
         AND a.archive_inserted_rows = a.latest_run_row_count
         AND ca.current_archived_slice_rows = a.latest_run_row_count
         AND ca.current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count = a.latest_run_row_count
         AND ca.current_archived_slice_null_archive_ts_rows = 0
         AND ca.option_c_latest_run_archive_gap_count = 0
         AND ca.option_c_archive_reason_trace_gap_count = 0
         AND ad.duplicate_archive_grain_count = 0
            THEN 'SECTION_12_ARCHIVE_PERSISTENCE_READY_FOR_COMPARISON_AND_QA'

        ELSE 'REVIEW_SECTION_12_ARCHIVE_PERSISTENCE_BEFORE_COMPARISON_OR_QA'
    END AS section_12_archive_persistence_status

FROM audit_row a
CROSS JOIN current_archive ca
CROSS JOIN archive_duplicates ad
CROSS JOIN inventory_diff id;
```

## Step 2 — Safe recovery path

Run this archive schema-sync block, then rerun **Section 12 from the beginning of Section 12.2 / archive table setup through the end of Section 12**.

```sql
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Targeted archive schema sync for latest-run columns.

Purpose:
    Add any latest-run columns missing from credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive.

Why this is needed:
    If the archive table existed before Option C fields were added, the archive may not yet contain:
        counteroffer_strategy_variant
        aggressive_counteroffer_expansion_enabled
        ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_flag
        aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag
        and related Option C control fields.

Important:
    This only aligns schema.

    After this runs, rerun Section 12 persistence so the current archived M2-01 slice is deleted and
    reinserted with the Option C values populated.

Boundary:
    This block does not modify latest-run rows.
    This block does not recalculate decisions.
    This block does not recalculate reason codes.
    This block does not insert archive rows by itself.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

DO $$
DECLARE
    add_col RECORD;
BEGIN
    IF TO_REGCLASS('credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions') IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 archive schema sync failure: credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions does not exist. Rerun Section 11 first.';
    END IF;

    IF TO_REGCLASS('credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive') IS NULL THEN
        EXECUTE
            'CREATE TABLE credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive
             (LIKE credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions INCLUDING DEFAULTS)';
    END IF;

    FOR add_col IN
        SELECT
            latest_att.attname AS column_name,
            pg_catalog.format_type(latest_att.atttypid, latest_att.atttypmod) AS column_type
        FROM pg_attribute latest_att

        JOIN pg_class latest_cls
            ON latest_cls.oid = latest_att.attrelid

        JOIN pg_namespace latest_ns
            ON latest_ns.oid = latest_cls.relnamespace

        WHERE latest_ns.nspname = 'credit_decisioning_sim'
          AND latest_cls.relname = 'strategy_decisions'
          AND latest_att.attnum > 0
          AND latest_att.attisdropped IS FALSE
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM pg_attribute archive_att

              JOIN pg_class archive_cls
                  ON archive_cls.oid = archive_att.attrelid

              JOIN pg_namespace archive_ns
                  ON archive_ns.oid = archive_cls.relnamespace

              WHERE archive_ns.nspname = 'credit_decisioning_sim'
                AND archive_cls.relname = 'strategy_decisions_archive'
                AND archive_att.attnum > 0
                AND archive_att.attisdropped IS FALSE
                AND archive_att.attname = latest_att.attname
          )
        ORDER BY latest_att.attnum
    LOOP
        EXECUTE FORMAT(
            'ALTER TABLE credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS %I %s',
            add_col.column_name,
            add_col.column_type
        );
    END LOOP;

    ALTER TABLE credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive
        ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS archive_inserted_ts TIMESTAMP;
END $$;
```

```sql
        ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS
        AS
        WITH latest_key AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                strategy_set_name,
                strategy_name,
                strategy_version,
                module1_scenario_set_name,
                module1_scenario_name,
                population_id
            FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
        ),

        latest_run AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
        ),

        archived_slice AS (
            SELECT ar.*
            FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ar

            JOIN latest_key k
                ON k.strategy_set_name = ar.strategy_set_name
               AND k.strategy_name = ar.strategy_name
               AND k.strategy_version = ar.strategy_version
               AND k.module1_scenario_set_name = ar.module1_scenario_set_name
               AND k.module1_scenario_name = ar.module1_scenario_name
               AND k.population_id = ar.population_id
        ),

        latest_archive_compare AS (
            SELECT
                COALESCE(sd.application_id, ar.application_id)
                    AS application_id,

                sd.application_id AS latest_application_id,
                ar.application_id AS archive_application_id,

                CASE
                    WHEN sd.application_id IS NULL
                      OR ar.application_id IS NULL
                        THEN TRUE
                    ELSE FALSE
                END AS application_presence_gap_flag,

                CASE
                    WHEN sd.application_id IS NOT NULL
                     AND ar.application_id IS NOT NULL
                     AND (%s)
                        THEN TRUE
                    ELSE FALSE
                END AS latest_archive_field_mismatch_flag,

                CASE
                    WHEN sd.application_id IS NULL
                      OR ar.application_id IS NULL
                        THEN TRUE

                    WHEN sd.counteroffer_strategy_variant
                            IS DISTINCT FROM ar.counteroffer_strategy_variant
                      OR sd.aggressive_counteroffer_expansion_enabled
                            IS DISTINCT FROM ar.aggressive_counteroffer_expansion_enabled
                      OR sd.severe_requested_structure_counteroffer_override_enabled
                            IS DISTINCT FROM ar.severe_requested_structure_counteroffer_override_enabled
                      OR sd.exposure_extreme_counteroffer_override_enabled
                            IS DISTINCT FROM ar.exposure_extreme_counteroffer_override_enabled
                      OR sd.exposure_policy_stop_counteroffer_override_enabled
                            IS DISTINCT FROM ar.exposure_policy_stop_counteroffer_override_enabled
                      OR sd.requested_pti_decline_counteroffer_override_enabled
                            IS DISTINCT FROM ar.requested_pti_decline_counteroffer_override_enabled
                      OR sd.requested_el_decline_counteroffer_override_enabled
                            IS DISTINCT FROM ar.requested_el_decline_counteroffer_override_enabled
                      OR sd.ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_flag
                            IS DISTINCT FROM ar.ordinary_counteroffer_candidate_flag
                      OR sd.aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag
                            IS DISTINCT FROM ar.aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag
                        THEN TRUE

                    ELSE FALSE
                END AS option_c_latest_archive_mismatch_flag

            FROM latest_run sd

            FULL OUTER JOIN archived_slice ar
                ON ar.application_id = sd.application_id
        ),

        archive_reason_trace AS (
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
                ) AS aggressive_override_archived_rows,

                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
                      AND decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                ) AS aggressive_override_archived_counteroffer_rows,

                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
                      AND decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                ) AS aggressive_override_archived_manual_review_rows,

                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
                      AND decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                ) AS aggressive_override_archived_decline_rows,

                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE aggressive_counteroffer_requested_structure_override_flag IS TRUE
                      AND (
                            (
                                decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                                AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') NOT LIKE
                                    '%%COUNTEROFFER_AGGRESSIVE_EXPANSION_OVERRIDE%%'
                            )
                         OR (
                                decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                                AND preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                                AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
                                AND failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                                AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') NOT LIKE
                                    '%%MANUAL_REVIEW_AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE%%'
                            )
                         OR (
                                decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                                AND preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                                AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
                                AND failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'DECLINE'
                                AND COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') NOT LIKE
                                    '%%POLICY_STOP_AGGRESSIVE_COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE%%'
                            )
                      )
                ) AS aggressive_override_reason_trace_gap_count

            FROM archived_slice
        ),

        summary AS (
            SELECT
                /***********************************************************************************
                Current latest-run identity.
                ***********************************************************************************/
                (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM latest_key
                ) AS latest_run_key_count,

                (
                    SELECT STRING_AGG(
                        CONCAT_WS(
                            ' | ',
                            strategy_set_name,
                            strategy_name,
                            strategy_version,
                            module1_scenario_set_name,
                            module1_scenario_name,
                            population_id
                        ),
                        ' ; '
                        ORDER BY
                            strategy_set_name,
                            strategy_name,
                            strategy_version,
                            module1_scenario_set_name,
                            module1_scenario_name,
                            population_id
                    )
                    FROM latest_key
                ) AS latest_run_key_description,

                /***********************************************************************************
                Row-count and application-grain checks.
                ***********************************************************************************/
                (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM latest_run
                ) AS latest_run_row_count,

                (
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
                    FROM latest_run
                ) AS latest_run_distinct_application_id_count,

                (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM archived_slice
                ) AS archived_slice_row_count,

                (
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
                    FROM archived_slice
                ) AS archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count,

                (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM latest_archive_compare
                    WHERE application_presence_gap_flag IS TRUE
                ) AS application_presence_gap_count,

                /***********************************************************************************
                Full latest-run versus archive field comparison.

                This is the strongest post-session check because it compares every latest-run column
                against the archived slice.
                ***********************************************************************************/
                (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM latest_archive_compare
                    WHERE latest_archive_field_mismatch_flag IS TRUE
                ) AS latest_archive_field_mismatch_count,

                /***********************************************************************************
                Option C preservation checks.
                ***********************************************************************************/
                (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM latest_archive_compare
                    WHERE option_c_latest_archive_mismatch_flag IS TRUE
                ) AS option_c_latest_archive_mismatch_count

            FROM latest_archive_compare
            LIMIT 1
        )

        SELECT
            s.latest_run_key_count,
            s.latest_run_key_description,

            s.latest_run_row_count,
            s.latest_run_distinct_application_id_count,

            s.archived_slice_row_count,
            s.archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count,

            s.application_presence_gap_count,
            s.latest_archive_field_mismatch_count,
            s.option_c_latest_archive_mismatch_count,

            rt.aggressive_override_archived_rows,
            rt.aggressive_override_archived_counteroffer_rows,
            rt.aggressive_override_archived_manual_review_rows,
            rt.aggressive_override_archived_decline_rows,
            rt.aggressive_override_reason_trace_gap_count,

            CASE
                WHEN s.latest_run_key_count = 1
                 AND s.latest_run_row_count > 0
                 AND s.latest_run_row_count = s.latest_run_distinct_application_id_count
                 AND s.archived_slice_row_count = s.latest_run_row_count
                 AND s.archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count = s.latest_run_row_count
                 AND s.application_presence_gap_count = 0
                 AND s.latest_archive_field_mismatch_count = 0
                 AND s.option_c_latest_archive_mismatch_count = 0
                 AND rt.aggressive_override_reason_trace_gap_count = 0
                    THEN 'M2_LATEST_RUN_AND_ARCHIVE_VERIFIED'

                ELSE 'REVIEW_M2_LATEST_RUN_AND_ARCHIVE_BEFORE_CONTINUING'
            END AS post_session_archive_verification_status

        FROM summary s
        CROSS JOIN archive_reason_trace rt
        $SQL$,
        v_compare_predicate
    );
END $$;

SELECT *
FROM tmp_m2_post_session_archive_verification;
```

Use this replacement for 4.4.9:

```sql
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.4.9 Requested Expected Loss alias confirmation.

Purpose:
    Confirm that Module 1 expected_loss_amount was preserved and aliased into
    requested_expected_loss_amount.

Expected:
    requested_expected_loss_mismatch_rows = 0.

Interpretation:
    requested_expected_loss_amount is the requested-exposure Expected Loss from Module 1.

    approved_expected_loss_amount is created later after exposure treatment.

Implementation note:
    The mismatch count is calculated with FILTER so the average and total metrics remain visible
    across the full staged population even when no mismatches exist.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_expected_loss_amount
    ) AS requested_expected_loss_mismatch_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE expected_loss_amount IS NULL
    ) AS module1_expected_loss_null_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE requested_expected_loss_amount IS NULL
    ) AS requested_expected_loss_null_rows,

    AVG(expected_loss_amount) AS avg_module1_expected_loss_amount,
    AVG(requested_expected_loss_amount) AS avg_requested_expected_loss_amount,

    SUM(expected_loss_amount) AS total_module1_expected_loss_amount,
    SUM(requested_expected_loss_amount) AS total_requested_expected_loss_amount

FROM tmp_m2_stage_1_source_applications;
```

```sql
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Purpose:
    Summarize requested-structure affordability segmentation before rule-trigger construction.

Interpretation:
```

```sql
5.4.8 Requested Expected Loss tier summary.

Purpose:

Interpretation:

    It does not calculate approved Expected Loss.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    'Requested Expected Loss tiers are product-policy-relative; portfolio-level min/max ranges and aggregate averages can overlap or appear non-monotonic because product mix and product thresholds differ by tier.'::TEXT
        AS interpretation_note,

    CASE requested_expected_loss_tier
        WHEN 'LOW_REQUESTED_EL' THEN 1
        WHEN 'MODERATE_REQUESTED_EL' THEN 2
        WHEN 'ELEVATED_REQUESTED_EL' THEN 3
        WHEN 'HIGH_REQUESTED_EL' THEN 4
        WHEN 'SEVERE_REQUESTED_EL' THEN 5
        ELSE 99
    END AS requested_expected_loss_tier_rank,

    requested_expected_loss_tier,

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    ROUND(
        COUNT(*)::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0),
        6
    ) AS pct_of_stage2_rows,

    MIN(requested_expected_loss_amount)
        AS min_requested_expected_loss_amount,

    AVG(requested_expected_loss_amount)
        AS avg_requested_expected_loss_amount,

    MAX(requested_expected_loss_amount)
        AS max_requested_expected_loss_amount,

    AVG(requested_amount)
        AS avg_requested_amount,

    AVG(estimated_pd)
        AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy,

    AVG(estimated_lgd)
        AS avg_estimated_lgd,

    COUNT(DISTINCT product_type_policy_key)
        AS distinct_product_type_policy_key_count

FROM tmp_m2_stage_2_strategy_segments

GROUP BY requested_expected_loss_tier

ORDER BY
    requested_expected_loss_tier_rank,
    requested_expected_loss_tier;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5.4.8A Requested Expected Loss tier × product mix breakdown.

Purpose:
    Explain the product-mix composition behind requested Expected Loss tier behavior.

Why this exists:
    The aggregate requested Expected Loss tier summary can show non-monotonic average dollar values
    across HIGH and SEVERE tiers because the tiers are product-policy-relative.

    This diagnostic shows which product types contribute to each requested Expected Loss tier.

Interpretation:
    pct_of_requested_el_tier:
        Within a requested Expected Loss tier, the share contributed by each product type.

    pct_of_product_type:
        Within a product type, the share of that product's rows that fall into each requested
        Expected Loss tier.

Documentation use:
    Use this table when explaining why an aggregate HIGH_REQUESTED_EL average can exceed an aggregate
    SEVERE_REQUESTED_EL average.

    Product mix, product caps, product LGD, requested amount, and product-specific requested-EL
    thresholds can all influence the aggregate tier-level averages.

Boundary:
    This is a Section 5 segmentation diagnostic.

    It does not modify product policy.
    It does not assign rule-trigger flags.
    It does not calculate approved Expected Loss.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

WITH product_tier_summary AS (
    SELECT
        requested_expected_loss_tier,
        product_type_policy_key,

        COUNT(*) AS row_count,

        MIN(requested_expected_loss_amount)
            AS min_requested_expected_loss_amount,

        AVG(requested_expected_loss_amount)
            AS avg_requested_expected_loss_amount,

        MAX(requested_expected_loss_amount)
            AS max_requested_expected_loss_amount,

        AVG(requested_amount)
            AS avg_requested_amount,

        AVG(estimated_pd)
            AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy,

        AVG(estimated_lgd)
            AS avg_estimated_lgd

    FROM tmp_m2_stage_2_strategy_segments

    GROUP BY
        requested_expected_loss_tier,
        product_type_policy_key
),

product_tier_with_totals AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,

        SUM(row_count) OVER (
            PARTITION BY requested_expected_loss_tier
        ) AS requested_el_tier_total_rows,

        SUM(row_count) OVER (
            PARTITION BY product_type_policy_key
        ) AS product_type_total_rows,

        SUM(row_count) OVER ()
            AS stage2_total_rows

    FROM product_tier_summary s
)

SELECT
    'Requested Expected Loss tier × product mix explains aggregate tier averages; tiers are product-policy-relative and product composition can make HIGH vs SEVERE aggregate averages appear inverted.'::TEXT
        AS interpretation_note,

    CASE requested_expected_loss_tier
        WHEN 'LOW_REQUESTED_EL' THEN 1
        WHEN 'MODERATE_REQUESTED_EL' THEN 2
        WHEN 'ELEVATED_REQUESTED_EL' THEN 3
        WHEN 'HIGH_REQUESTED_EL' THEN 4
        WHEN 'SEVERE_REQUESTED_EL' THEN 5
        ELSE 99
    END AS requested_expected_loss_tier_rank,

    requested_expected_loss_tier,
    product_type_policy_key,

    row_count,

    ROUND(
        row_count::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(requested_el_tier_total_rows, 0),
        6
    ) AS pct_of_requested_el_tier,

    ROUND(
        row_count::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(product_type_total_rows, 0),
        6
    ) AS pct_of_product_type,

    ROUND(
        row_count::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(stage2_total_rows, 0),
        6
    ) AS pct_of_stage2_rows,

    min_requested_expected_loss_amount,
    avg_requested_expected_loss_amount,
    max_requested_expected_loss_amount,

    avg_requested_amount,
    avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy,
    avg_estimated_lgd

FROM product_tier_with_totals

ORDER BY
    requested_expected_loss_tier_rank,
    requested_expected_loss_tier,
    CASE product_type_policy_key
        WHEN 'MORTGAGE' THEN 1
        WHEN 'HELOC' THEN 2
        WHEN 'AUTO_LOAN' THEN 3
        WHEN 'UNSECURED_PERSONAL_LOAN' THEN 4
        WHEN 'REVOLVING_LINE' THEN 5
        ELSE 99
    END,
    product_type_policy_key;
```

```sql
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6.4.20 Requested PTI bucket × affordability trigger summary.

Purpose:
    Review requested affordability trigger behavior by Section 5 requested PTI bucket.

Why this diagnostic needs an interpretation note:
    Section 6 trigger flags are intentionally allowed to overlap.

    A row can carry:
        requested_pti_counteroffer_candidate_flag
        and
        requested_pti_review_trigger_flag

    or:
        requested_pti_counteroffer_candidate_flag
        and
        requested_pti_decline_trigger_flag

    at the same time.

    This is not automatically contradictory.

    Section 6 records rule-trigger evidence.
    Section 7 applies the route-priority hierarchy.

Boundary:
    requested_payment_to_income_ratio is requested-structure PTI.

    It is not approved PTI.

    approved_payment_to_income_ratio is not created until the exposure-treatment and final-resolution
    layers.

Documentation note:
    requested_pti_bucket_tier_rank preserves the intended bucket order in CSV exports.

    affordability_trigger_pattern provides a compact interpretation of the grouped flags.

Boundary:
    This is a QA / interpretation diagnostic only.

    It does not change rule flags.
    It does not assign preliminary routing.
    It does not assign final decision outcomes.
    It does not calculate approved affordability.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

WITH affordability_trigger_rows AS (
    SELECT
        requested_pti_bucket,

        CASE requested_pti_bucket
            WHEN 'LOW_REQUESTED_PTI' THEN 1
            WHEN 'MODERATE_REQUESTED_PTI' THEN 2
            WHEN 'ELEVATED_REQUESTED_PTI' THEN 3
            WHEN 'HIGH_REQUESTED_PTI' THEN 4
            WHEN 'SEVERE_REQUESTED_PTI' THEN 5
            ELSE 99
        END AS requested_pti_bucket_tier_rank,

        requested_pti_clean_band_flag,
        requested_pti_counteroffer_candidate_flag,
        requested_pti_review_trigger_flag,
        requested_pti_decline_trigger_flag,

        COALESCE(requested_pti_clean_band_flag::INT, 0)
      + COALESCE(requested_pti_counteroffer_candidate_flag::INT, 0)
      + COALESCE(requested_pti_review_trigger_flag::INT, 0)
      + COALESCE(requested_pti_decline_trigger_flag::INT, 0)
            AS requested_pti_trigger_flag_count,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    ' + ',

                    CASE
                        WHEN requested_pti_clean_band_flag IS TRUE
                            THEN 'CLEAN_AFFORDABILITY_BAND'
                    END,

                    CASE
                        WHEN requested_pti_counteroffer_candidate_flag IS TRUE
                            THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_CANDIDATE_PRESSURE'
                    END,

                    CASE
                        WHEN requested_pti_review_trigger_flag IS TRUE
                            THEN 'REVIEW_PRESSURE'
                    END,

                    CASE
                        WHEN requested_pti_decline_trigger_flag IS TRUE
                            THEN 'DECLINE_PRESSURE'
                    END
                ),
                ''
            ),
            'NO_REQUESTED_PTI_TRIGGER_PATTERN'
        ) AS affordability_trigger_pattern,

        requested_payment_to_income_ratio,
        estimated_pd,
        requested_expected_loss_amount,
        debt_to_income_ratio,
        affordability_trigger_count,
        total_rule_trigger_count

    FROM tmp_m2_stage_3_rule_flags
)

SELECT
    'Section 6 requested-PTI trigger flags are overlapping non-final rule evidence; Section 7 applies route priority, so counteroffer/review/decline trigger overlap is expected and not automatically a defect.'::TEXT
        AS interpretation_note,

    requested_pti_bucket_tier_rank,
    requested_pti_bucket,

    affordability_trigger_pattern,
    requested_pti_trigger_flag_count,

    requested_pti_clean_band_flag,
    requested_pti_counteroffer_candidate_flag,
    requested_pti_review_trigger_flag,
    requested_pti_decline_trigger_flag,

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    ROUND(
        COUNT(*)::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0),
        6
    ) AS pct_of_stage3_rows,

    MIN(requested_payment_to_income_ratio)
        AS min_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,

    AVG(requested_payment_to_income_ratio)
        AS avg_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,

    AVG(affordability_trigger_count)

    AVG(total_rule_trigger_count)
        AS avg_total_rule_trigger_count,

    AVG(estimated_pd)
        AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy,

    AVG(debt_to_income_ratio)
        AS avg_debt_to_income_ratio,

    AVG(requested_expected_loss_amount)
        AS avg_requested_expected_loss_amount

FROM affordability_trigger_rows

GROUP BY
    requested_pti_bucket_tier_rank,
    requested_pti_bucket,

    affordability_trigger_pattern,
    requested_pti_trigger_flag_count,

    requested_pti_clean_band_flag,
    requested_pti_counteroffer_candidate_flag,
    requested_pti_review_trigger_flag,
    requested_pti_decline_trigger_flag

ORDER BY
```

```sql
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7.4.3 Count by preliminary_decision_priority_rank.

Purpose:
    Show route-priority distribution.

Interpretation:
    Lower rank means higher-priority preliminary route.

    Priority ranks are fixed route-priority slots.

    A missing rank in a specific run means that zero rows populated that route family in the current
    strategy / scenario slice.

    A missing rank does not mean the priority sequence is broken.

    This query helps reviewers see how much of the population is being routed by severe stop
    conditions versus counteroffer feasibility, severe requested-structure review, manual review,
    clean approval, or residual review.

Route-priority reference:
    1 = HARD_POLICY_STOP
    2 = SEVERE_SYNTHETIC_RISK
    3 = SEVERE_DTI_CAPACITY
    4 = COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_CHECK
    5 = SEVERE_REQUESTED_STRUCTURE_REVIEW
    6 = MANUAL_REVIEW_CANDIDATE
    7 = CLEAN_APPROVAL_CANDIDATE
    8 = RESIDUAL_STRATEGY_REVIEW

Boundary:
    preliminary_decision_priority_rank is a route-ordering label.

    It is not a reason-code priority rank.
    It is not a final decision rank.
    It is not a final outcome severity score.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    'Priority ranks are fixed route-priority slots; absent ranks indicate zero rows for that route family in this run, not a numbering error.'::TEXT
        AS interpretation_note,

    preliminary_decision_priority_rank,

    CASE preliminary_decision_priority_rank
        WHEN 1 THEN 'HARD_POLICY_STOP'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'SEVERE_SYNTHETIC_RISK'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'SEVERE_DTI_CAPACITY'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_CHECK'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'SEVERE_REQUESTED_STRUCTURE_REVIEW'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW_CANDIDATE'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'CLEAN_APPROVAL_CANDIDATE'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'RESIDUAL_STRATEGY_REVIEW'
        ELSE 'UNEXPECTED_PRIORITY_RANK'
    END AS preliminary_priority_slot_label,

    preliminary_decision_path,
    preliminary_route_reason_family,

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*)::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_of_stage

FROM tmp_m2_stage_4_preliminary_decision_routing

GROUP BY
    preliminary_decision_priority_rank,
    preliminary_decision_path,
    preliminary_route_reason_family

ORDER BY
    preliminary_decision_priority_rank,
    preliminary_decision_path,
    preliminary_route_reason_family;
```

```sql
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7.4.16 Counteroffer candidate flag × preliminary_decision_outcome.

Purpose:
    Confirm that governed counteroffer candidates route to preliminary COUNTEROFFER and that rows
    without the governed candidate flag do not route to preliminary COUNTEROFFER.

Interpretation:
    counteroffer_candidate_flag is the governed route-eligible counteroffer candidate flag.

    counteroffer_candidate_trigger_count is broader diagnostic pressure evidence.

    A row can have counteroffer-adjacent trigger pressure while still not satisfying the governed
    counteroffer_candidate_flag because higher-priority policy, risk, DTI, severe requested-structure,
    product-permission, or other gating logic may prevent it from being a candidate.

Expected:
    counteroffer_candidate_flag = TRUE should map to preliminary_decision_outcome = COUNTEROFFER.

    preliminary_decision_outcome = COUNTEROFFER should not appear when counteroffer_candidate_flag is
    FALSE.

Boundary:
    This is preliminary routing.

    A preliminary COUNTEROFFER route means the row should be tested for counteroffer feasibility in
    Section 8.

    It does not mean a final COUNTEROFFER has been approved.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    'counteroffer_candidate_flag is the governed route-eligible flag; trigger counts are broader overlapping pressure evidence and can be nonzero even when the row is not a governed counteroffer candidate.'::TEXT
        AS interpretation_note,

    counteroffer_candidate_flag,
    preliminary_decision_outcome,

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*)::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_of_stage,

    AVG(counteroffer_candidate_trigger_count)
        AS avg_counteroffer_candidate_trigger_count,

    AVG(total_rule_trigger_count)
        AS avg_total_rule_trigger_count,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE requires_counteroffer_feasibility_flag IS TRUE
    ) AS requires_counteroffer_feasibility_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE requires_approved_exposure_calculation_flag IS TRUE
    ) AS requires_approved_exposure_calculation_rows

FROM tmp_m2_stage_4_preliminary_decision_routing

GROUP BY
    counteroffer_candidate_flag,
    preliminary_decision_outcome

ORDER BY
    counteroffer_candidate_flag DESC,
    CASE preliminary_decision_outcome
        WHEN 'APPROVE' THEN 1
        WHEN 'COUNTEROFFER' THEN 2
        WHEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW' THEN 3
        WHEN 'DECLINE' THEN 4
        ELSE 99
    END;
```

```sql
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8.4.4 Count by counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag.

Purpose:
    Summarize pass / fail behavior for rows routed to preliminary COUNTEROFFER feasibility testing.

Interpretation:
    counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag is evaluated only for preliminary COUNTEROFFER rows.

    A TRUE value means Section 8 produced a viable reduced-exposure preliminary counteroffer.

    A FALSE value means Section 8 tested the row but did not produce a viable preliminary
    counteroffer under the governed product cap, minimum amount, minimum counteroffer percent,
    maximum exposure-reduction, approved PTI target, approved Expected Loss cap, and rounding rules.

Documentation note:
    counteroffer_feasibility_pass_rate and counteroffer_feasibility_fail_rate are calculated against
    the preliminary COUNTEROFFER population, not the full 50,000-row strategy population.

Boundary:
    This is a preliminary feasibility diagnostic.

    A passed preliminary counteroffer does not become a final COUNTEROFFER until Section 9.
    A failed preliminary counteroffer remains unresolved until Section 9 applies the governed
    failed_counteroffer_resolution parameter.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

WITH preliminary_counteroffer_rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment
    WHERE preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
),

counteroffer_feasibility_summary AS (
    SELECT
        counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag,

        COUNT(*) AS row_count,

        AVG(counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count)
            AS avg_counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count,

        AVG(requested_amount)
            AS avg_requested_amount,

        AVG(approved_amount_preliminary)
            AS avg_approved_amount_preliminary,

        AVG(exposure_reduction_amount_preliminary)
            AS avg_exposure_reduction_amount_preliminary,

        AVG(exposure_reduction_pct_preliminary)
            AS avg_exposure_reduction_pct_preliminary,

        AVG(requested_payment_to_income_ratio)
            AS avg_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,

        AVG(approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary)
            AS avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary,

        AVG(requested_expected_loss_amount)
            AS avg_requested_expected_loss_amount,

        AVG(approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary)
            AS avg_approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary

    FROM preliminary_counteroffer_rows

    GROUP BY counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag
),

total_preliminary_counteroffer_rows AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_counteroffer_rows
    FROM preliminary_counteroffer_rows
)

SELECT
    'Pass/fail rates are calculated within preliminary COUNTEROFFER rows only; Section 8 tests feasibility, while Section 9 resolves the final simulated outcome.'::TEXT
        AS interpretation_note,

    s.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag,

    s.row_count,

    ROUND(
        s.row_count::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(t.total_counteroffer_rows, 0),
        6
    ) AS pct_of_preliminary_counteroffer_rows,

    CASE
        WHEN s.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
            THEN ROUND(
                s.row_count::NUMERIC
                / NULLIF(t.total_counteroffer_rows, 0),
                6
            )
        ELSE 0::NUMERIC
    END AS counteroffer_feasibility_pass_rate,

    CASE
        WHEN s.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
            THEN ROUND(
                s.row_count::NUMERIC
                / NULLIF(t.total_counteroffer_rows, 0),
                6
            )
        ELSE 0::NUMERIC
    END AS counteroffer_feasibility_fail_rate,

    s.avg_counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count,

    s.avg_requested_amount,
    s.avg_approved_amount_preliminary,
    s.avg_exposure_reduction_amount_preliminary,
    s.avg_exposure_reduction_pct_preliminary,

    s.avg_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,
    s.avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary,

    s.avg_requested_expected_loss_amount,
    s.avg_approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary

FROM counteroffer_feasibility_summary s

CROSS JOIN total_preliminary_counteroffer_rows t

ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN s.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE THEN 1
        WHEN s.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE THEN 2
        ELSE 99
    END;
```
